versions.changelog:
x2c-real-dashboard 1.0.0

- Initial release of the skill for querying real-time X2C dashboard data.
- Provides scripts to fetch KPI overview, earnings trends, platform performance, recent activity, and earning project lists.
- Supports specific natural language triggers for each dashboard action.
- Uses X2C API key from environment for all queries.
- Built-in error handling returns JSON with success status and error message.
